name: RealStudio
tagline: One platform from robot control to on-site deployment.
description: Robot control, teleoperation, data collection, annotation and cleaning, VLA and RL post-training, motion recording, and multi-robot monitoring and remote teleoperation.

capabilities.label: Control
capabilities.heading: Connect and teleoperate your robots.
capabilities.description: Connect robots, view live status and sensor data, and teleoperate with data gloves or vision-based hand tracking.

capabilities.label: Collect
capabilities.heading: Collect and manage robot data.
capabilities.description: Record synchronized vision, language, action, depth, IMU, and tactile data. Review episodes and manage dataset versions, imports, and exports.
features: Dataset management, versioning, import and export

capabilities.label: Train
capabilities.heading: Post-train VLA and RL policies.
capabilities.description: Annotate and clean data, post-train π0.5 and Isaac GR00T N1.7, and train humanoid or quadruped locomotion policies.
features: Data annotation, cleaning and quality checks
VLA post-training: π0.5 and Isaac GR00T N1.7
RL locomotion training: humanoid and quadruped

capabilities.label: Deploy
capabilities.heading: Run multiple robots on site.
capabilities.description: Monitor and teleoperate robots many-to-many over LAN. Use the Runtime SDK for policy-driven control, or record actions and select them at runtime.
features: Many-to-many monitoring and remote teleoperation over LAN

editions.name: Data
features: Dataset management, versioning, import and export

editions.name: Training
features: VLA: π0.5 and Isaac GR00T N1.7

editions.name: Deployment
features: Many-to-many monitoring and teleoperation over LAN

editionNote: Data, Training, and Deployment each include every Free feature. Enterprise includes every feature listed.
